outcome: Complications at birth (e.g., hypoglycemia, birth trauma)
Type of feeding during maternity stay
cohort: 179 newborns with birth weights >4000 grams, born in 6 large maternity hospitals in Romania
finding: Macrosomic newborns had a high prevalence of cesarean section delivery (54%), birth trauma, and a low rate of exclusive breastfeeding at discharge (32%).
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was more common in the macrosomic newborns (54% of the study group).
